milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the light gray terracotta cluster (centered at spawn-relative [4, 1, 4], the eye-level block of the L-shaped pillar) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the target'. The sandbox confirmed the terracotta is ~5.6 blocks from spawn at coordinates (~4,0-1,4) and (~5,0,4). max_distance=16 allows detection from anywhere in the compact scene, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the blocks rather than facing away.
